title: Disc stack

reference.source: Reference 9: dithered screen print of a stacked disc spring, 736 × 1282 px JPEG
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: A stack of lit disc rims and a gray column, all screened by one random dither, between two line-screen flanks whose three color plates slip where the sheet warps.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 736 × 1282 and every length scales with the canvas

rings.does: Number of discs in the stack.

discW.does: Half the long axis of each ellipse.

discH.does: Short axis as a share of the long one: a flat disc seen nearly edge-on, or a fuller one.

rim.does: Width of the lit band; it is thickest at the front of each disc and 4 times thinner at the back.

halo.does: Dithered glow inside and outside the solid band.

sag.does: Bends the discs: positive bows the lower ones down and the upper ones up.

column.does: Width of the gray dithered column behind the stack.

gray.does: Speck coverage of the column: the tone the dither is screening.

grain.does: Cell size of the dither grid. The grid is resampled to the sheet, so a cell above 1 px gives each speck a soft ramp.

tooth.does: Low-frequency noise multiplied into the tone before the threshold; clumps the specks. Black stays black.

dust.does: Stray half-tone specks the screen leaves on the unprinted black: 0.004 is one cell in 250.

soft.does: Ink spread after the screen; turns a hard dither into the gray speckle of the print.

chain.does: Width of the dark band beside the column where the lines print only as chains of specks.

chainPitch.does: Spacing of the fine vertical lines.

chainTone.does: How much of each fine line reaches the threshold: 0.4 breaks it into specks, 1 prints it solid.

stripes.does: Width of the printed stripe zone outside the chains.

pitch.does: Line spacing of the color screen.

beat.does: The second screen is this many lines per cycle finer; their beat sets where the stripes print full and where they fade to chains.

flare.does: A slow field that opens the stripes to full print in patches regardless of the beat, and spreads the color plates apart there.

warp.does: Sideways wave of the sheet that bends every line.

misreg.does: How far the red and blue plates sit off the green one. 0 prints every stripe one color.

phase.does: Position along the loop. Runs the sheet warp down the flanks.

seed.does: Re-rolls the dither and the flare field.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: The gray column: specks at 50 % coverage, 2 px median area, blurred 0.7 px so the tone reads as speckle rather than a hard dither.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: A disc rim: solid white 14 px thick at the front, thinning toward the back, with a dithered halo on both sides.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: Stripes at 11 px pitch, full print where the beat is high: yellow where the red and green plates overlap, green and cyan at the slipped edges.

pass_order: tone field: a gray column 0.34 of the width, with soft edges

flanks: a chain screen (pitch 9.5 px, raised cosine to the 6th power, tone 0.42) beside the column; outside it a stripe screen (pitch 11 px) whose print depth is the beat of that screen against one 8 lines finer, opened further by a slow flare field
the sheet warp: one sine of 330 px wavelength, scaled by noise, bends every line in the flanks
disc rims: ellipses 0.78 of the half width, short axis 0.17 of the long, a solid band 14 px thick at the front thinning to 3.5 px at the back, a dithered halo, faint inner arcs
the screen: one hashed threshold per pixel; the tone goes through it as speck density
color plates: the green plate on the stripe lines, the red plate on it, the blue plate slipped 0.12 pitch and widened where the flare field is high; screened by the same threshold

measured.rim_method: rows above 190 luminance through the column center at each ring row
measured.column_hist: near flat from bin 1 to bin 14, 13.6 % in bin 0 and 10.5 % in bin 15: a soft dither
measured.chain_evidence: column-mean autocorrelation peak at lags 9 to 10
measured.stripe_evidence: autocorrelation peaks at 11, 22, 34 on the right flank; 14 on the left
measured.stripe_hues: yellow (234,229,111) 80 % of saturated pixels, yellow-green (188,223,125) 7 %, cyan-green (101,193,167) 2 %, blue (64,120,157) 1.5 %

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Screen print palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The stack has 9 discs instead of 11 and a bowed spacing, so the ring patches were placed with search.py on the plate's own discs; the column, chain, stripe and edge patches sit on the same zones as the reference.

limits: Benchmark mean 0.91. The chain band scores lowest (autocorrelation 0.71, contrast 0.77): the reference chains are ragged 1 px lines of gray specks that wander, the plate's are a cosine line 2 px wide through a 1.8 px dither grid with 5-cell streaks, so they sit straighter and print whiter.

Column texture spectrum 0.81: the reference dither was resampled from a smaller image, which rounds every speck; the plate resamples a 1.8 px grid with Catmull-Rom and blurs 0.6 px, which gets the flat histogram but keeps more energy at 0.2 cycles per pixel.
The stack is the plate's own: 9 discs with a bow, against 11 straight discs 92 px apart in the reference.
The reference flanks carry a second, slower warp and hand-masked flare shapes; the plate uses one 330 px sine scaled by noise and a value-noise flare field.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
